flashcard_questions.q: What do the darned patches on Mickey’s shorts show the audience?
flashcard_questions.a: That Mrs Johnstone mends clothes rather than replacing them.

flashcard_questions.q: Which colour links Mickey’s costume to the Labour Party?
Which colour links Edward’s costume to the Conservative Party?
What does Mrs Johnstone’s pink costume communicate?
flashcard_questions.a: Warmth and a loving, romantic nature.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does young Mrs Johnstone wear no tights?
What does Mrs Johnstone wearing tights later in the play suggest?
flashcard_questions.a: She can finally afford small luxuries after moving to Skelmersdale.

flashcard_questions.q: What does young Mrs Lyons’ tailored grey suit communicate?
flashcard_questions.a: Her formal nature and high social status.

flashcard_questions.q: What does older Mrs Lyons’ mismatched footwear show?
flashcard_questions.a: Her paranoia has consumed her and she no longer cares about appearance.

flashcard_questions.q: Which costume item signals Mr Lyons’ Conservative politics?
As a child Linda wears bright ____, the colour of happiness and enthusiasm.
flashcard_questions.a: Yellow, which dulls as adult life wears her down.

flashcard_questions.q: What does Mickey’s faded adult clothing show?
flashcard_questions.a: He still cannot afford new clothes.

flashcard_questions.q: Why should no character except the Narrator wear a mask?
flashcard_questions.a: The play relies on naturalistic facial expressions to communicate emotion.

flashcard_questions.q: How does Mrs Lyons’ hair change in Act Two?
flashcard_questions.a: It becomes wild and unkempt, signalling her mental deterioration.

flashcard_questions.q: What make-up would show young Mrs Johnstone’s exhaustion?
What does Edward’s adult tweed jacket suggest?

notes: 15 cards: 8 costume-detail→meaning, 2 colour-symbolism, 1 cloze on Linda’s yellow, 2 hair and make-up, 1 mask rule, 1 causal. Each character’s full costume list was split so one card carries one signifier; the shoes, socks and shirt detail for Mickey and Edward was reduced to the two details that carry the class contrast.
